decided: When an outside review that the AI started on its own fails, the AI does not start it again; it stops and hands the review back to the user.
alternatives: count the record a failed launch writes before the review runs as progress, where progress means a new record on the change's trail since the AI last ran the command
why: The AI runs the next command again only when the last one made progress, meaning a new record on the change's trail since it ran. A failed launch still writes a record before the review runs; if that record counted, every failed launch would look like progress and a broken reviewer would start over and over without end.
